Re:  Securities and Exchange Commission, et al. v. Michelle Cochran, 

No. 21-1239 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

Respondent in the above-captioned case respectfully requests that the Court 
accept for filing the reply brief that was submitted to the Court today.  Under this 
Court’s Rule 25.3, the deadline for filing the reply brief was September 7, 2022.   

Due  to  an  internal  scheduling  error,  counsel  for  respondent  mistakenly 
calendared  the  deadline  for  the  reply  brief  as  September  8,  2022.   Following 
coordination with the government on the proposed briefing realignment and schedule 
in this case (in which counsel had proposed September 8, 2022 as the due date for the 
reply brief), counsel for respondent calendared the reply brief for internal purposes 
as being due on the proposed September 8 date.  But counsel failed to adjust that date 
to account for the fact that the briefing schedule submitted by the government and 
accepted by the Court did not include a deadline for the reply brief. 

Counsel for respondent did not become aware of this internal oversight until 
this afternoon (after the brief had been sent to the printer) and immediately notified 
the  Clerk’s  office.    Counsel  for  respondent  has  conferred  with  counsel  for  the 
government, and the government consents to the filing of the reply brief. 

Counsel sincerely apologizes for this oversight and for any inconvenience to the 

Court, and respectfully requests that the Court accept the reply brief for filing.

Hon. Scott S. Harris 
September 8, 2022 
Page 2 

Respectfully submitted, 

Gregory G. Garre 
of LATHAM & WATKINS LLP 
Counsel of Record for Respondent 

cc:  Honorable Elizabeth B. Prelogar
